name: Gästehaus Tyrol
beschreibung: The Gästehaus Tyrol is located in Söll, Tirol, Österreich. The accommodation is an inn with overnight accommodations. The location is in the village center, near the gondola lift. Guests have access to a restaurant with regional dishes. The rooms are equipped with a bathroom and functionally furnished. The house has a lounge and a terrace. Wi-Fi and parking are provided. The surrounding area is suitable for hiking and skiing.
